purpose: Supplement recovery-ledger-2026-08-29.json with newly verified federal MFCU and civil-settlement records while preserving overlap warnings.

entries.interpretation: HHS-OIG's July 1 recertification letter quotes Minnesota MFCU's FY2025 annual statistical report as reporting more than $24M in total monetary recoveries. The aggregate combines recovery types and should not be added to component settlements or restitution without overlap reconciliation.

Total federal/state settlement resolving allegations; DOJ states there was no determination of liability or wrongdoing. Because it was resolved in FY2025 with Minnesota MFCU involvement, it may be included in the >$24M FY2025 MFCU aggregate.
Minnesota Attorney General says Minnesota receives more than $8M. This is nested within the $18.5M total and must not be added to it.
Minnesota-attributable amount in the national CVS insulin-pen False Claims settlement.
Direct restitution to Minnesota Medical Assistance reported by the Minnesota Attorney General. It is nested within the >$850K Minnesota-attributable settlement amount and is not criminal restitution.

overlap_rules: Do not add NUWAY's $18.5M total to its >$8M Minnesota share.
Do not add CVS's >$850K Minnesota-attributable settlement to its >$400K direct Medicaid restitution component.
Do not add individual FY2025 settlements, restitution, or recoveries to Minnesota MFCU's >$24M FY2025 total unless the annual statistical report establishes they are excluded from that aggregate.
Do not combine MFCU FY2025 >$24M recoveries with the AG's 2019-2026 $90M judgments-and-recoveries aggregate as if they are separate time periods; FY2025 is nested inside the longer period.
Recovered or settled amounts remain distinct from DHS identified-for-recovery and Optum potential-recovery/cost-avoidance measures.
